fights.topuria-gaethje: Gaethje absorbed Topuria's sharpest early work, stayed composed under fire, and broke the champion down over four rounds before a corner stoppage.
fights.pereira-gane: Gane denied Pereira's bid for a title in a third division, using his natural-heavyweight frame and range to find a second-round finish.
fights.o-malley-zahabi: O'Malley returned with a second-round finish in a matchup that never posed the wrestling problem his recent losses came from.
fights.hokit-lewis: Hokit used pace and athleticism to neutralize Lewis's one-shot power and finish in the second.
fights.ruffy-chandler: Ruffy punished Chandler's early entries and ended it inside a round, making the decline-and-pace concern look real.
fights.nickal-daukaus: Nickal finished in the first and flashed finishing development beyond the narrow wrestling-only read.
fights.lopes-garcia: Garcia's early danger did not override Lopes's level; Lopes weathered it and finished in the second.
